newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast lt. crude falls, ANS done at -$0.91.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast lt. crude falls, ANS done at -$0.91.

text.p: U.S. West Coast Alaskan crude weakened Thursday after a cargo of the grade sold at a wider discount than yesterday's deal, traders said.

A major West Coast refiner sold to another refiner at -$0.91 cents under April West Texas Intermediate (WTI). The shipment, confirmed by both sides, contains over 300,000 barrels of Alaska North Slope (ANS) crude.
The deal was 11 cents wider than the - $0.80 cent deal done Wednesday.
Traders said the deal completes West Coast refiners' April demands.
